limitations: Observed cases only, not full XML/name/native parity. XML replay differences are retained as observed.
System-library identities are captured receipts; only packaged prefix libraries and fonts physically rehashed.
Native warnings/failures preserved verbatim, including timestamps/PIDs/pointers if present.
No native external-link prohibition instrumented; product resolver counters are separate evidence.
collectorCorrection: The 4138695-byte identity receipt exceeded the local authenticator old 4000000-byte cap. Raised its bounded identity read to8000000, then completed all identity, manifest, binary/module/library/font and raw-stream assertions.
nativeLifecycle: Native ms-excel-read.c finalizer removes active #NAME? placeholders. High-index ordinary names first parse to #NAME?, but a top-level #NAME? definition is later removed and references become #REF!. Guarded definitions retain their internal #NAME? constants and evaluate7. Qualified missing targets become #REF! immediately.
